Step 1 (TARGET ENGAGEMENT): The combination therapy likely engaged its targets - androgen receptor pathway (via leuprolide/bicalutamide) and microtubules (via docetaxel) based on established mechanisms and appropriate dosing. Step 2 (PATHWAY MODULATION): PSA recurrence data suggests biological activity with median time to recurrence of 31 months, indicating pathway modulation occurred. Step 3 (CLINICAL TRANSLATION): The primary endpoint was 2-year PSA progression-free survival rate, with 17/26 participants achieving this (65.4%). However, without a control group or historical comparison, it's impossible to determine if this represents meaningful clinical benefit. Step 4 (POPULATION EFFECTS): No subgroup analyses reported. Step 5 (CONFOUNDERS): Major limitation is single-arm design preventing assessment of treatment effect versus natural history. Small sample size (n=26) also limits interpretability.
